name: proofbundle
description: Verify decision and outcome receipts against a chosen issuer key, check evidence bundles, and separate verification results from recorded claims. Guard is a separate preview area and requires its hooks to be installed and trusted. In that area a plain Codex git push warns without blocking; other recognized write forms may be denied as unbound. An installed git pre-push hook is a separate, bypassable local check. Verification checks authorship and integrity of recorded bytes, not whether the recorded values are true. Receipt signing is experimental; the emit skill requests explicit invocation and confirmation, but host enforcement is not measured.
